description: This PHP source file defines the class 'TrackerQueriesDatabaseStore', which implements the 'Store' interface. It manages database operations related to tracking query metrics, including updating existing records or inserting new metrics into a database table. The class is part of the Tracker module in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM extension.

classes.name: TrackerQueriesDatabaseStore
classes.description: A class that handles database storage of tracker query metrics, either updating existing records or inserting new ones based on the monitor's data.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Saves monitor metrics to the database, updating existing records if run_count > 1, or inserting new data otherwise.
